event: A plain white corridor leads from the salt flats to a single unmarked door: the Proving Gate.
Solenne finds it nothing like the picture she had built.
Tomás had flagged it only as "terminal structure, uncertain classification."
The party stops at the corridor's entrance.
The Resonant Stalkers' signal vanishes as the party enters the corridor.
Dayo looks at the door, holding weight she has not converted.
Miriam asks what it does.
Solenne shares the Proving Gate notice: private, simultaneous Bond Trials.
Tomás notes "simultaneously" and models a party with no mutual support.
Vesper points out that passive Harmony connection is not nothing.
Solenne says she'll feel them all through the Conductor but can't act.
Nadia, dulcimer case on her back, asks if it's one at a time.
Solenne says all five go in at once; Tomás notes five, not six.
Dayo says, "Okay," and adjusts her tally bracer; Nadia echoes her.
They walk through the door into a white antechamber with five doors.
Five doors open; Dayo, Miriam, Vesper, Tomás and Nadia each enter one, and they close.
Solenne sits against the wall and opens the Conductor to full bandwidth.
She feels all five signals only as faint presence through stone.
Dayo's signal holds weight without converting it.
After four minutes Dayo's signal shifts to weight accepted.
Dayo walks out of the left door, tally bracer in her hands.
Solenne tells her fifteen minutes; Dayo sits against the opposite wall.
Dayo's trial completes; she rises to Level 14 and gains Iron Will.
Dayo rereads Iron Will and works out how it changes Defiant Last Stand.
Dayo asks if Nadia is still in; Solenne says yes.
Solenne feels Miriam's Warmhearted signal sink to its lowest register.
Miriam comes out at eighteen minutes, looking as if she has cried.
Miriam sits near Dayo, and Dayo moves to sit beside her.
Miriam opens her notebook, writes nothing, and closes it.
Miriam asks Dayo for the Mana Vial; Dayo already has it out.
Miriam's trial completes.
Miriam drinks the vial, hands it back and leans against the wall.
Solenne feels Vesper's Artificer signal simplify to the Openhanded beneath.
Vesper comes out after twelve minutes, looking at her hands.
Vesper says the trial gave her nothing to make and she thought she would fail.
Solenne says she didn't; Vesper sits and says she didn't need it.
Vesper's trial completes.
Dayo calls twelve minutes fast; Vesper asks if it is.
Dayo says it might just be what the trial needed.
Solenne reads Tomás's signal reach a conclusion around minute eight and go still.
Tomás comes out at twenty minutes and asks if Nadia is still in.
Solenne says yes; Tomás exhales and sits against the wall.
Tomás says he said something wrong in there: right thing, wrong moment.
Vesper tells him the trial ended and he's here; he nods.
Tomás's trial completes.
Four wait; the fifth door stays shut and Dayo watches it.
Solenne reads Nadia's signal as open and present, and only receives it.
Eleven minutes pass.
The fifth door opens and Nadia walks out.
Nadia looks at each of them in turn, Solenne last, without speaking.
Solenne reads Nadia's Brightspirit signal as unchanged by the trial.
Nadia asks if they're all done; Solenne says eleven minutes.
Nadia's trial completes.
Nadia reads "one forty-two"; she and Solenne agree: eight to go.
Something brief shifts in Nadia's signal as she looks at the others.
Nadia sits between Tomás and the entry door: "Okay. Eight more."
The five trial doors are closed again; the System gives no next step.
Dayo says they should eat; Miriam agrees.
They eat.
